_comment: Setup + controller configuration reference for this capture, added retrospectively (2026-06-26) to match the existing log-analysis setup.json convention. Captured by tools/telemetry/udp_telem_sniff.py --raw-bin (VREC). Decoders: tools/telemetry/{analyze_pitch_osc,pitch_verify,pitch_lag}.py.
capture_type: Clean 30 s PID telemetry on the D-LPF build (compiled defaults). The reference PID pitch-oscillation capture.

hardware.airframe: X-quad. M1,M3 CW / M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned. A motor was burned earlier in the 2026-06-25 session; pitch axis suspected physically asymmetric.
hardware.conditions: tethered/bench (throttle constrained <=0.35; prior to the first explicit open-air run)

motor_geometry._comment: Inverted spin vs firmware default (flips s_mix_yaw only). Roll/pitch mix unchanged. REQUIRED.

firmware.rate_controller_algo: PID cascade (RATE_CTRL_PID), D-LPF fix build (d_lpf_rc 0.004 on roll/pitch so the rig-tune Kd is no longer filtered out).
firmware.tune_applied: NONE — running compiled variables.h defaults. The pid.bin magic was bumped PID2->PID3 (added CMD_SET_D_LPF persistence), invalidating any prior persisted tune; operator confirmed no tune re-applied post-boot.
firmware.note: FC does not persist tunes across power cycles.

pid._units: rate: controller=1; angle: controller=0 (kp in (deg/s)/deg). Compiled variables.h defaults, ACTIVE this capture.

pitch.status: seeded from roll; own sysid pending (limit-cycles)

headline: Pitch relay/saturation limit cycle at 1.77 Hz (pitch out railed 71 %, motors floor 63 %); roll rock-stable. Outer loop innocent, NO transport delay — a saturation-driven cycle, not a gain problem. Decomp: tools/telemetry/{analyze_pitch_osc,pitch_verify,pitch_lag}.py.
